mechanism_inventory: stale accounting snapshot (gas price/ZRC20 mapping not updated atomically)
missing invariant enforcement (no zero-address check in setGasCoinZRC20; no bounds on price in setGasPrice)
wrong lifecycle ordering (gasCoinZRC20 vs gasZetaPool mappings inconsistent)
value exceeds bound (gas price 0 or huge manipulating fee calc)
external-call / DoS (downstream consumers revert on invalid values)
victim accounting direction (users overcharged/undercharged from manipulated gas price)

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: No zero-address validation in setGasCoinZRC20: accepts any address incl address(0) and stores in gasCoinZRC20ByChainId[chainID]. Unlike setWZETAContractAddress/setConnectorZEVMAddress which revert ZeroAddress, setGasCoinZRC20 has no guard.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Privileged — requires FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS to call setGasCoinZRC20(chainID, address(0)) via bug/misconfig/compromise.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. setGasCoinZRC20(chainID, address(0)). 2. mapping stores zero. 3. downstream IZRC20(gasCoin).method calls into address(0) — silent failure/unexpected. 4. cross-chain fee/deposit for that chainID broken until corrected.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Users doing cross-chain ops for affected chainID (revert/incorrect ZRC20).
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: No financial gain; DoS for that chain.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: setGasCoinZRC20 lacks the ZeroAddress check present in sibling functions — design asymmetry; DoS of cross-chain ops for a chainID; auditable even if privileged.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: No bounds on price in setGasPrice: accepts any uint256 incl 0 or huge. price=0 -> users pay no cross-chain gas (underpayment); huge price -> all cross-chain ops infeasible (economic DoS).
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Privileged — FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS calls setGasPrice(chainID, 0 or max).
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. setGasPrice(chainID, 0). 2. fee calc yields 0; users pay zero fees -> revenue loss/validator underpay. Alt max: cross-chain txns for chainID infeasible -> DoS.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Protocol (revenue at 0) or users (DoS at max).
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: Users bypass fees at 0; nobody at max.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: setGasPrice has no lower/upper bound; missing invariant; affects economic correctness; Medium+.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: Mapping inconsistency gasCoinZRC20ByChainId vs gasZetaPoolByChainId after setGasCoinZRC20 without pool update
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: setGasCoinZRC20 updates coin mapping but not gasZetaPoolByChainId; pool address computed from old wZeta+old erc20 becomes stale.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether downstream consumers use the stale pool and whether it causes fund loss or degraded routing — requires consumer source.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: Users routing cross-chain swaps through stale gasZetaPool.

rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: both functions begin with if (msg.sender != FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS) revert CallerIsNotFungibleModule();
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Non-module callers revert; no spoofing msg.sender in standard EVM.

impact_direction.victim_loses: Users lose ability to execute cross-chain ops for affected chainID (DoS); protocol loses fee revenue if price=0.
impact_direction.invariant_violated: Cross-chain gas oracle integrity: gasCoinZRC20ByChainId may store address(0); gasPriceByChainId may store invalid price; mapping consistency not enforced.
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: DoS/oracle manipulation affect all users of the affected path; privileged-caller required but impact protocol-wide once executed.
